title: Jack Rabbit Cyber Rabbit Radon 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid - 5mg
description: Radon Rabbit from Jack Rabbit’s Cyber collection is a thrillingly sweet yet refreshing berry flavour e-liquid with a super-sharp edge. Treat your tastebuds to the delicious combination of plump, ripe Raspberries and crisp, sharp Cranberries. As you can imagine, such a combo dances close to sour, but pulls back just enough to offer a deliriously smooth and fruity vape that will have your tastebuds pleading for more. With the addition of a cooling dose of Menthol detectable on the exhale, this exquisite e-liquid also offers much refreshment and brings the blend of flavours together with magical results. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
